state: Goal `core-time-datetime`: `Core\Time\DateTime::date`, `::dayOfYear`, `::difference`, `::toInstant`, `::timeOfDay`, `::zone`, `::weekday` and `::isLeapYear` have every feature proof on disk except their perf figure, which the driver's sweep records (`perf: stale` until then, because `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs` moved). `bun nv proofs --id` still prints `help: Core\Time\DateTime has no class card` for them. That comes from a stale binary: the card is at `time.rs:1589` and the class is off `CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD`. The `zone` example found that `format("VV")` printed `UTC` for a fixed-offset zone. That is fixed in `cldr::render`, which now renders the same `±HH:MM[:SS]` id `zone()` returns, and it is pinned in `tests/conformance/core/time-datetime-parts-agree-with-the-value-they-came-from.nvst` and in `datetime_zone_is_the_id_it_reads_in_and_the_one_vv_renders`. The Rust tests for the four view members use `zone_view_samples()` and `datetime_view(member, &at, read)` at the end of the `time.rs` test module. Reuse them for the next members. Nothing is blocked.
